imported_product_sources.name: SDRAM controller (ported) and pin-level device model (original)
imported_product_sources.intermediate_source: bui-bui https://github.com/amichai-bd/bui-bui.git revision 1dfadf5437777a705ae1c72b58423869adb495e4 (the last change to the copied files; repository HEAD f2044a70a3a54ad2ad88735bf5e0cbe06706a5ad at the port): src/rtl/mafia/sdram/mafia_sdram_pkg.sv sha256 df7a53d16c5eda397526b0c98b9618ce154bb3733bf313a48c7dc6a02a139b3f, src/rtl/mafia/sdram/mafia_sdram_ctrl.sv sha256 e58854eab9b60b69a19125f8e6069cf5599ab1e0d895c16741042026f2daa062; MIT-licensed adaptation of the FPGA-MAFIA SDRAM controller for the DE10-Lite at 25 MHz, CL2, BL8. src/dv/mafia/mafia_sdram_device_model.sv sha256 10afc9fe8d44ce936a2208220e7222440ba0699c27e6dfa82b6d153794234e05 was read as a method reference only.
imported_product_sources.notices: MIT SPDX notice and source attribution at the head of src/rtl/storage/n2m_sdram_pkg.sv and n2m_sdram_ctrl.sv; the bui-bui LICENSE text is MIT as recorded here
imported_product_sources.purpose: Adapted SDRAM controller and original pin-level device model for the game library; contract in wiki/src/rtl/storage/MAS_sdram.md
imported_product_sources.local_changes: Renamed into the n2m namespace (n2m_sdram_pkg, n2m_sdram_ctrl); repository DFF_ARST_VAL register macro and N2M_ASSERT vocabulary with the contract assertion names; contract line interface with initialized output; POWERUP counts 5000 clocks after reset release; read_data is no longer cleared at acceptance so the response holds until the next read; one REFRESH_INTERVAL parameter defaulting to the package constant; DRAM_DQ declared inout tri; timing constants unchanged. n2m_sim_sdram.sv is an original model written against the ISSI datasheet edge counts, not a copy.
imported_product_sources.storage: src/rtl/storage (controller, package and simulation model) and src/dv/storage (fixtures)
